# Art Studio crab demo

`art-crab.png` is original AI-generated demonstration artwork for Luma Studio. It is not a camera photograph, a biological reference, an image from the user's attachments, or a result produced by Luma's own filters. No screenshot, social-media interface, logo or copyrighted crab photograph was supplied as an image-generation input.

## Generation prompt

Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: original photographic demo source for a photo-to-art editor. Primary request: one entire red-orange cooked crab, directly overhead, with both claws and all legs naturally spread and separated clearly, shell facing the camera. Style: highly detailed natural macro product photography, honest fine shell texture, small highlights and subtle natural irregularities. Composition: a square image, the complete animal centered within the middle 78 percent, generous transparent margin on every side, no limb or claw cropped. A clean readable silhouette with openings between the legs. Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no floor, no plate, no cast shadow outside the crab. Soft studio lighting without hard white clipping. No text, no logos, no watermark, no UI. No other objects. This must be a new original image, not a screenshot or a copy of any referenced social media image.

## Framing edit prompt

Edit this generated crab asset only to improve framing. Keep the same complete photographic crab, fine shell texture, pose, colors, claws and all legs intact. Scale the entire crab down to fit the central 75 percent of a square transparent canvas, center it. Ensure at least 10 percent truly empty transparent margin at left, right, top and bottom. Clean exact transparent cutout, with no detached alpha specks or alpha holes inside the shell or legs. No text, no floor or cast shadow, no other objects. Do not crop, hide or erase any body part.

## File and inspection

- PNG RGBA, 1254 × 1254 pixels, 1,566,564 bytes.
- SHA-256: `bec4c285207801ca2534f04ce367c3e85e73e8bdf57c021094e78ab48414f3cd`.
- Full limbs are visible; alpha above 8/255 occupies `(81,195)–(1178,1087)`, leaving at least 76 px clear framing around the meaningful subject.
- There are a few trace alpha values of 1/255 near the left border; they were not manually removed. Four sampled central shell pixels have alpha 253/255. Transparency is genuine rather than a baked checkerboard.
- Generation and edit used the built-in tool. The selected PNG was copied unchanged into this project; no manual raster modification was applied.

This asset is suitable for demonstrating selectable styles and foreground patterns. It does not validate photographic fidelity, perfect cutout accuracy, or the quality of every user image.
